nfl.notes: Compact EPA/QB challenger beat the calibrated form baseline on margin MAE, total MAE, and winner accuracy in true walk-forward validation; prospective monitoring remains required.

cfb.notes: Full-history PIT-safe Ridge research model using 2004-2026 event/context data. Market remains benchmark-only. Frozen fit trained through 2025.

soccer.notes: SOCCER-FBIS-v2 beat v1 on the same 7,759-match true expanding walk-forward sample: accuracy 49.86% vs 49.72%, Brier 0.20269 vs 0.20376, log loss 1.01608 vs 1.02130, ECE 0.00450 vs 0.01101. On the retained 206-game Zen ACTION no-vig sample, v2 top-pick accuracy was 52.43% vs market 51.46%, but probability scoring remained worse (Brier 0.20559 vs 0.20064; log loss 1.03236 vs 1.00506), so market promotion did not pass. Optional xG/xGA, PPDA, deep completions and expected-points fields activate only when rights-cleared upstream data exists. Prospective research continues; wager authority remains off. SOCCER-FBIS-v3 is the PitchAPI advanced-data shadow challenger. It remains behind v2 until PitchAPI history is backfilled and true walk-forward/market gates improve probability quality. Historical actual lineups are never treated as pre-kick evidence; only lineup observations captured before kickoff are eligible. Player-impact and lineup layers are stored for prospective shadow evaluation and are not yet allowed to alter v3 probabilities.

nba.notes: Independent NBA score/margin/total/possession distribution feeds a strict point-in-time game-level wager decision engine. Offered line/juice, ordinary market trajectory and ACTION intelligence are separate post-projection layers. ACTION is shadow market intelligence only and cannot directly qualify or authorize. Confidence is provisional until empirical monotonicity passes; stake units remain withheld until staking validation. Player props now have an EPM-inspired FBIS-native impact layer: dynamic skill decay + SPM-style prior + regularized RAPM + lineup/on-off + role redistribution. EPM/DARKO/RAPM/VORP/WS48 are research benchmarks only.
nba.deepGameNotes: Four Factors, PBP shot profile, actual venue travel/rest, altitude/fatigue, expected lineup strength, availability context and learned nonlinear interactions. 2025-26 holdout is burned; promotion requires 2026-27 prospective evidence.

wnba.notes: WNBA incumbents remain active. The new FBIS-native EPM-style player-impact stack uses dynamic skill decay, a WNBA-specific SPM prior, regularized RAPM, 10-minute-quarter lineup reconstruction, lineup/pair/trio effects, and point-in-time role redistribution. Historical direct self-impact multipliers did not improve four core prop MAEs and were rejected. Role/lineup/availability effects remain prospective shadow challengers until they beat incumbents on out-of-sample error, offered-line side accuracy, CLV and wagering evidence.
